Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff — working session timing and pre-read package

Hi Jennifer —

Thanks again for the chat earlier. We're excited to kick off the hands-on POC and propose a 90-minute working session where we'll: 

- Do a short intro (5 min) and align on goals/success criteria
- Prompt review & best-practice walkthrough (20 min) — bring 3 canonical prompts you want to test
- Routing & model variant demo (15 min) — how we route by latency/cost/policy
- KV/prefix caching demo (10 min) and how to measure cache hit rate
- Load test plan & run (30 min) — ramp + steady-state + cleanup
- Next steps & mutual action plan (10 min)

Proposed time slots (PT):
- Thu 2026-02-12 09:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 2026-02-12 13:00–14:30 PT
- Fri 2026-02-13 08:00–09:30 PT

I've attached a short agenda and a prep questionnaire to collect the prompts, expected SLOs, and any IP/egress restrictions. Can you confirm which slot works for your team and whether anyone from infrastructure should join?

Attachments: POC_Kickoff_Agenda_v1.pdf, prep_questionnaire.md

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime

Cc: Product Ops <pm@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — working session timing and pre-read package

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks — appreciate the clear agenda. We have a calendar conflict on Thu morning PT. Could we move to Thu 2026-02-12 at 11:00 AM ET (which should be 08:00 PT) or 2:00 PM ET (11:00 PT)? Our infra lead (pm@acme.ai) should join for the load test section.

For the load test, please plan for two phases: a short warm-up (5–10 min) and a ramp to 400–600 RPS sustained for 15–20 min. We'll want to capture latency P95/P99, error rate, and CPU/GPU utilization. Also note we have a strict egress policy — any logs or traces with customer data need to be redacted or routed to our VPN. 

I've attached a quick note on our SLA expectations.

Attachments: ACME_SLA_requirements.pdf

Best,
Jennifer Frost
VP Product, Acme AI

I've attached an internal runbook checklist for the session. Keep notes on any configuration that would require a Dedicated capacity exception or special routing.

Attachments: internal-runbook-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Kim
